description: Texas Instruments TPS2113APWR auto-switching 2-input power mux, 3.1 x 4.5 mm TSSOP-8. The device's high-side FETs block reverse and cross-conduction; it is used here to select a separately regulated battery 5 V branch or a host 5 V inlet.
name: tps2113apwr
watch_out_for: TPS2113A has an active-high EN disable input; this circuit uses a pull-down for automatic operation and a removable shunt to assert disable. IN1 is the host-priority input through VSNS; do not hard-tie IN1 and IN2.
